page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel computing workloads. It is powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor with 16 dedicated physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 120 GB of system memory, providing 7.5 GB per core. For hardware acceleration, it integrates two NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPUs with a combined 32 GB of VRAM. Local storage is provided via a bundled 944 GB SSD, and network connectivity is rated at a 5 Gbps baseline.

Benchmark results indicate a clear performance profile. Single-core CPU performance is relatively low, with stress-ng single-core scoring in the bottom 10% and single-threaded compression tasks registering as weak. However, multi-core scaling is more robust, with stress-ng multi-core and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression achieving average tier performance. Memory bandwidth is stable, reaching 683.87 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 56.56 GB/sec for large uncached reads. The instance also demonstrates capable throughput in database and web operations, processing 10.88 million Redis SET operations per second and delivering 9.91 GB/sec in static web serving.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5-c8g1.4xlarge offers a balanced entry point for legacy GPU-accelerated workloads. While the Pascal-generation GPUs and Broadwell-era CPUs do not match the raw performance of newer architectures, the inclusion of local SSD storage and a high memory-to-vCPU ratio provides solid resource density. This server is suited for workloads such as legacy deep learning training, GPU-accelerated database queries, scientific simulations, and multi-threaded data processing pipelines that benefit from dedicated hardware acceleration without requiring the latest generation silicon.
